title: A Seek, Test, and Treat Intervention to Reduce Chlamydia Trachomatis Disparities
official: A Seek, Test, and Treat Intervention to Reduce Chlamydia Trachomatis Disparities in Black Youth Living in the Deep South
summary: This study includes testing for four STIs (chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, and HIV) at no cost. If positive, individual subjects will also be counseled and offered options for treatment for themselves and their sex partners that may include no cost expedited treatment and the option to be rescreened 3 months after treatment.

interventions.name: Chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, and HIV screening

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Identifies as African American or Black
* 15-26 years of age
* Lives or spends most of their time in Orleans Parish
* Had vaginal sex at least once
* Provide a urine or vaginal swab
* Not taken azithromycin or cefixime in the last 7 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling or unable to provide informed consent
* Unable to speak or understand English
* Previously enrolled in the study
